Evidence-Guided Search

LingSante-3.1-air-VL is trained to search for missing information and assess whether the evidence is sufficient. Search trajectories and training sampling are optimized to reduce redundant work. https://t.co/NRHYCFkDda

Training for Better Imaging Reports

LingSante-3.1-air-VL learns to connect findings in medical images with diagnostic impressions. Its reinforcement learning objectives account for clinical meaning, abnormality location, false positives and missed findings. https://t.co/zrVchzvoWi

Navigating Healthcare Apps

Booking appointments and ordering medication take multiple steps. LingSante-3.1-air-VL reads app screens and interacts with buttons and fields to help users navigate these workflows. https://t.co/V8BqaoQ0ni

From Images to Evidence

Similar images can have different medical meanings. LingSante-3.1-air-VL uses image-based search to find related cases and literature, then checks the evidence to support its analysis. https://t.co/9vqQkEqjLN

Multimodal Health Analysis

Health images need context. LingSante-3.1-air-VL pairs skin photos with symptom history, identifies ingredients and estimates portions in meals, and interprets lab reports to suggest next steps. https://t.co/PqEOLfXH9A

From Chest X-Ray to Report

A chest X-ray needs a structured interpretation. LingSante-3.1-air-VL generates reports with Findings and Impression sections. This is for research only and does not replace a physician's diagnosis. https://t.co/jPDGi4w4Wp

note_tweet.text:
Meet LingSante-3.1-air-VL, an open-source multimodal medical model with 124B total and 5.5B active parameters. It combines medical image understanding, report generation and medical reasoning with multimodal search and tool use.
In our evaluation, it leads the compared models on AFUMED-Derm, AFUMED-Report, MIMIC-CXR and medical VQA (averaged across benchmarks), ahead of GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash on all four.
It also demonstrates strong general-purpose capabilities, scoring higher than GPT-6.1 Sol on BrowseComp-VL and Gemini 3.8 Flash on AndroidWorld, alongside competitive performance on MMSearch. Explore LingSante-3.1-air-VL and build with it.

Long-Horizon Task Synthesis
LingSante-3.1-flash scales long-horizon tasks across real MCP, mock MCP and world-model environments. Tasks evolve across scenarios, tools and constraints. Cross-trajectory checks and task-level verifiers validate outcomes. https://t.co/W2fignjQhF

Professional Behavior Alignment
LingSante-3.1-flash uses a behavior matrix for training rewards. Physician annotation agreement is 99.62%. It leads on HBP (65.72) and trails only GPT-6 Astra on the chart’s three-benchmark medical behavior average. https://t.co/6Q2Ulxj9ai

Contribution-Aware Multi-Agent Search
LingSante-3.1-flash trains search agents with contribution-aware rewards. Against accuracy-only multi-agent RL, this improves accuracy while cutting total search steps by over 20%, balancing answer quality and cost. https://t.co/HBYf6cf2E1

Evidence-to-Capability Matching
LingSante-3.1-flash uses ECM to match medical evidence to reasoning goals. MEDPAR refines tasks through multi-agent review. Samples are checked for medical correctness and task consistency before entering training. https://t.co/tHSeXe9IOG

Interactive Consultation

In a simulated case of headache and one-sided weakness, LingSante-3.1-flash flags danger signs. It updates recommendations as examination results arrive. The exchange becomes a structured medical record for review. https://t.co/MbqwZvIPkR

Complex Medical Reasoning

Sleep analysis needs traceable measurements. LingSante-3.1-flash computes heart rate and HRV by sleep stage in YASA. It preserves heartbeat timestamps for signal review and leaves metrics blank when data are insufficient. https://t.co/zupcSvUXit

Model Introduction

From sleep analysis to evidence retrieval and interactive consultation, LingSante-3.1-flash tackles multi-step healthcare tasks. It combines medical reasoning, tool use and context-aware guidance to turn questions into actionable outputs. https://t.co/frgGLDS8wq
